name: foremost
desc: Console program to recover files based on their headers and footers
why: Carves files out of raw disk images by header and footer signatures, a clear window into how file formats are recognised.

brief.what_it_is: Foremost is a console program that recovers files from raw data by looking for their headers, footers, and internal data structures, a technique called data carving. It takes image files made by tools such as dd, Safeback, or EnCase, or it can read a drive directly. Header and footer signatures can come from a configuration file, or you can pick built-in file types on the command line. The output is the recovered files.
brief.why_it_exists: Foremost is a data carving tool for recovering files when the filesystem metadata is gone or unusable. The homepage says it was originally developed by the United States Air Force Office of Special Investigations and The Center for Information Systems Security Studies and Research, and was later opened to the general public.
brief.how_it_works: Foremost scans the raw bytes of an image or device for known header signatures and footer signatures, then cuts out the data between them. Built-in types go further and parse each format's internal data structures, which the homepage says makes recovery more reliable and faster than simple signature matching.
brief.standout: Built-in file types parse the format's internal structures rather than relying only on byte signatures, which the homepage presents as the reason for better reliability and speed. The same engine also accepts user-defined header and footer rules from a configuration file.
brief.status: unknown. The homepage shows no release date, version number, or last-commit date, and I did not follow the 'here' download link to check. The page has the look of an older SourceForge site and cites DFRWS 2006 and 2007.
brief.caveats: The homepage does not document any command-line usage, options, or output layout, so I could not verify the exact syntax. Its download link is labelled only 'here' and its URL was not visible in the fetched text. Licensing and supported platforms are not stated on the homepage. The sample test images it links to are a separate project, not part of the tool.
quotes: Foremost is a console program to recover files based on their headers, footers, and internal data structures.
These built-in types look at the data structures of a given file format allowing for a more reliable and faster recovery.
Originally developed by the United States Air Force Office of Special Investigations and The Center for Information Systems Security Studies and Research
